surface_grounding.method: AST-enumeration of the makepy-generated type library (methods with arity from FunctionDef, properties from _prop_map_get_), never transcription
surface_grounding.rule: every api entry must be IFace::method and resolve to a method of that interface with the declared arity, else the card is invalid

injection_policy: only cards whose readiness is verified-working may enter model context

unit_discipline.why: 实测：同一段里混写两层单位时，模型会把 mm/inch 的错按 x1000 去修，把可修的小错改成不可修的大错

user_parameters.rule: 字段值就是毫米；怀疑量纲错时用 x25.4 还原并核对是否为整数量程，绝不在这层用 x1000

com_arguments.layer: 调用 SOLIDWORKS API 的实参
com_arguments.rule: 只有跨到 COM 实参这一层才乘 0.001；这一层与用户参数层不可互相套用

engineering_invariants: PCD/2 - D_bolt/2 - D_hub/2 >= 1 mm (孔到凸台的间隙)
D_outer/2 - (PCD/2 + D_bolt/2) >= 2 mm (孔到外缘的轮缘)
chamfer < min((D_hub - D_bore)/2, t_base, H_total - t_base)

analytic_expectations.note: 每个特征的期望体积增量 mm^3，用于和回读 dv_mm3 逐条对照，不要凭印象判断体积是否合理

cards.name: 在前视基准面画圆草图 (sketch circle on Front Plane)
cards.coordinate_axiom: Front Plane normal is +Z; world Y is UP; sketch linear args are METRES

preflight.expect: GetActiveObject or ROT answers within startup timeout
feature tree contains 前视基准面 or Front Plane

silent_failures: COM 实参层填 mm 而非 m -> 几何放大 1000 倍，草图照样闭合、sketch 探针照样绿（这条只适用于跨到 API 的那一层，用户参数字段本身是 mm）
sketch closed with an open profile extrudes nothing and returns a feature object anyway
SelectByID2 on the Chinese plane name fails silently on an English install (and vice versa)

cards.name: 盲拉伸凸台 (blind boss extrusion)

postconditions.expression: mass property com_z >= 0 after base feature

silent_failures: FeatureExtrusion3 returns a feature even when nothing was added; only the volume delta proves it
wrong Dir flag grows the boss toward -Z, which the code corrects with EditUndo2 and a mirrored retry
EditRebuild3 written without parentheses is a no-op attribute read, not a rebuild

cards.name: 贯穿切除 (through cut)
silent_failures: IModelDoc2::FeatureCut3 also exists with 16 args (deprecated short form); calling it with 26 arguments fails at bind time while the IFeatureManager form is the one the executor measured working
an unscoped cut with no body selected returns Nothing on this box; NormalCut=False and UseFeatScope=True is the measured working flag set
a cut that fails the volume-reduction test is undone with EditUndo2, so a green status can hide three failed attempts
bolt-hole cut of a profile that broke out of the rim removes less material than analytic, and the 1% gate catches it

cards.name: 体积与质心回读 (mass property readback)
silent_failures: a part with no solid body yields Volume 0.0, which reads as a legitimate tiny flange unless n_bodies is checked
mp.CenterOfMass returns metres; forgetting *1000 makes the com_z sign test lie about stack direction

cards.name: 工程图国标标注 (drawing annotation to GB/T)

postconditions.expression: count(Dimension features after) - count(Dimension features before) == requested_dimension_count

silent_failures: center-mark counters read back 0 while the marks are visibly drawn, so a counter-only gate reports a false failure
residual block definitions produce phantom dimensions in the readback
evidence: memory: 工程图标注走 Extension/IDrawingDoc
